items.description: Leaders also call for Black Sea ceasefire to allow food exports as 1st step toward ending hostilities
items.author: Ayhan Simsek
items.excerpt: The leaders of Germany, France, the UK and Ukraine called on Russia on Thursday to agree to an “energy ceasefire” throughout the winter as a first step toward ending hostilities. items.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
items.description: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.
items.author: Jaroslav Lukiv
items.excerpt: European leaders have said they are ready for negotiations with Russia on ending the war in Ukraine, in a strong show of support for Kyiv. "Europe has a clear and consistent and united negotiating position," UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said, while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stressed that Moscow's "maximalist demands are not realistic". They were speaking at Berlin's summit of Ukraine's allies known as the Coalition of the Willing. US President Donald Trump's envoys were also there, and his son-in-law Jared Kushner said Trump wanted to make a deal with Russia "with Europe by his side".
